verdict: Yes, once a Claude model classifies. With Claude Sonnet 5, holistic classification got 0.89 of DocSplit sections exactly right, against 0.70 page by page, for about 15% fewer tokens (see SC-11). With the default, Amazon Nova 2 Lite, it is a trade: holistic grouped pages into documents far better (grouping score 0.90 against 0.66) but gave the wrong class to more pages (page accuracy 0.70 against 0.82), and the two tied on sections exactly right (0.55 against 0.52).
